top30召回:{}
SELECT
    spip.PERIODDATE AS `报告期`,
    spip.A_STOCKSNAME AS `股票简称`,
    spip.A_STOCKCODE AS `股票代码`,
    spip.ITEM_NAME AS `产品名称`,
    ROUND(spip.INCOME/10000, 3) AS `营业收入(亿元)`,
    spip.PRI_RVNU_PCT AS `营收占比(%)`
FROM
    STK_PRI_INCOME_PRODUCT spip
JOIN
    GET_A_SEC_CODE gasc
    ON spip.COMCODE = gasc.COMCODE AND gasc.ISVALID = 1
WHERE
    spip.ISVALID = 1
    AND gasc.SEC_SNAME LIKE '%万华化学%'
    AND spip.RPT_TYPE = '合并'
    AND spip.PERIODDATE = '2025-12-31 00:00:00.000'
    AND spip.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%聚氨酯%'
    AND spip.INCOME IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    spip.PERIODDATE DESC,
    spip.ITEM_NAME
